name: Shared atomic abuse protection

implementation.store: Existing PostgreSQL; atomic INSERT ON CONFLICT; no Redis or new paid service
implementation.identities: HMAC-SHA256 of endpoint category and server-verified identity; no raw IP/email/token in counter table
implementation.client_ip: CF-Connecting-IP only after OriginBoundary validates its configured edge secret; otherwise transport peer. Forwarded headers do not attest identity. Uvicorn proxy_headers remains false.
implementation.login: Reserve IP/account before bcrypt, release own IP on success/account refusal, release own slots on storage failure. Failed attempts persist across processes.
implementation.coverage: Existing limited actions converted to async shared storage; learner-scoped AI, video answers, uploads, archive, search and presence; Telegram identity limits including verified legacy callback.

ai_limits.retention_context: Existing shared vocabulary_search quota applies before dictionary/context work

implementation.failure_mode: No in-memory fallback in production. Counter store failure returns 503. Missing schema/signing key fails readiness.
implementation.cleanup: At most 8 old buckets removed on a newly used window; SKIP LOCKED; no idle polling job
implementation.normal_navigation: No blanket limiter middleware or additional rate-store query on ordinary session/navigation paths
